8ball.title: Ride TRAX to the End of the Line
8ball.description: Board whichever TRAX train arrives first downtown, ride it to the last stop, and find something to do within walking distance.
8ball.bonus: Eat at whatever is closest to the final platform.

8ball.title: Pick a Canyon, Take the First Trailhead
8ball.description: Drive to the mouth of whichever Wasatch canyon has the least traffic that morning, and hike from the first trailhead with a free parking space.
8ball.bonus: No checking the trail length first.

culture.title: A Play at Pioneer Theatre Company
culture.description: Utah's professional regional theatre, staging classic and new plays and musicals in a proscenium house on the U of U campus.
culture.bonus: Read the director's note before curtain.

culture.title: Organ Recital at the Tabernacle on Temple Square
culture.description: A free midday recital on one of the largest pipe organs in the world, in an 1860s hall famous for acoustics you can hear a pin drop in.
culture.bonus: Sit at the very back and see if you can hear the pin-drop demonstration.

culture.title: Broadway Show at the Eccles Theater
culture.description: Touring Broadway productions in a modern downtown theatre with a glass lobby that glows over Main Street at night.
culture.bonus: Get a drink in the lobby at intermission and look down Main Street.

culture.title: Natural History Museum of Utah
culture.description: A museum built into the foothills with a wall of dinosaur skeletons dug up in Utah and a top-floor terrace looking over the whole valley.

culture.title: Drive Out to the Spiral Jetty
culture.description: Robert Smithson's 1970 land-art coil of black basalt reaching into the pink water of the Great Salt Lake, at the end of a long dirt road.
culture.bonus: Walk the whole coil to the centre.

culture.title: Utah Arts Festival
culture.description: Four days downtown every June with artists' booths, stages of music and dance, a short-film tent and a lot of food.
culture.bonus: Buy one piece of art under $50.

culture.title: Utah Museum of Fine Arts
culture.description: The state's main art museum, on the University of Utah campus, with a strong collection of work from the American West.
culture.bonus: Pick one painting and give it ten full minutes.

culture.title: Dome Show at Clark Planetarium
culture.description: A domed theatre at The Gateway running star shows and space films, with free science exhibits you can walk through first.
culture.bonus: Pick the dome show, not the flat-screen film.

foodie.title: Oysters at Current Fish & Oyster
foodie.description: A buzzy seafood room in a converted downtown warehouse that has no business doing oysters this well a thousand miles from the ocean.
foodie.bonus: Order a half dozen from each coast and pick a winner.

foodie.title: Downtown Farmers Market at Pioneer Park
foodie.description: Saturday mornings in summer, Pioneer Park fills with Utah growers, food trucks and makers — the whole city seems to turn up with a coffee.
foodie.bonus: Build breakfast from three different stalls.

foodie.title: Pastrami Burger at Crown Burgers
foodie.description: Salt Lake's signature burger — a cheeseburger buried under a pile of shaved pastrami — with fry sauce on the side, at a local chain that has served it since 1978.
foodie.bonus: Dip everything in fry sauce, including things that shouldn't be.

foodie.title: Dirty Soda Run at Swig
foodie.description: Utah's drive-thru soda culture in one stop: Dr Pepper with coconut and lime, pebble ice and a sugar cookie on the side.
foodie.bonus: Invent your own mix from the flavour list and give it a name.

foodie.title: Dinner at Log Haven in Millcreek Canyon
foodie.description: A 1920s log mansion four miles up a mountain canyon, with a waterfall outside the window and a serious wine list inside.
foodie.bonus: Arrive early enough to walk down to the waterfall before you sit down.

foodie.title: Sushi Bar at Takashi
foodie.description: The downtown sushi spot locals rank above everything else in the state — worth the wait for a seat at the bar.
foodie.bonus: Let the chef choose your last three pieces.

foodie.title: Cheese Cave and Chocolate Wall at Caputo's
foodie.description: An Italian market and deli by Pioneer Park with its own cheese-aging cave and one of the biggest craft chocolate selections in the country.
foodie.bonus: Ask the counter for a chocolate you would never pick yourself.

foodie.title: Hot Chicken at Pretty Bird
foodie.description: Nashville-style hot chicken from a James Beard-nominated chef — a short menu done extremely well.
foodie.bonus: Go one heat level above what you think you can handle.

foodie.title: Mole Sampler at Red Iguana
foodie.description: Order the mole sampler at this legendary Mexican spot and pick your favorite of the seven sauces.
foodie.bonus: Ask your server which mole is their personal favorite.

foodie.title: Slice Night at Este Pizza
foodie.description: Grab a Detroit-style slice at Este and eat it on the patio with a local beer.
foodie.bonus: Order a topping you've never tried.

foodie.title: Mile-High Biscuits at Ruth's Diner
foodie.description: Drive up Emigration Canyon for giant mile-high biscuits at Utah's oldest continuously operating diner.
foodie.bonus: Order the biscuit even if you're not that hungry.

foodie.title: Tasting Menu at HSL
foodie.description: Settle in for chef Briar Handly's ever-changing seasonal tasting menu at one of Utah's best restaurants.
foodie.bonus: Let the sommelier pick your pairing.

social.title: Live Show at Kilby Court
social.description: A tiny all-ages venue in an old garage and courtyard that has hosted early shows by bands that later filled arenas.
social.bonus: Go see a band you have never heard of.

social.title: Après-Ski on Park City's Main Street
social.description: Ski off the mountain and straight into a historic mining-town main street lined with bars, starting at the No Name Saloon.
social.bonus: Ride the Town Lift down and walk into the first bar still in your boots.

social.title: Twilight Concert Series
social.description: Salt Lake's summer outdoor concert series — big-name acts, cheap tickets and a crowd that fills the park.
social.bonus: Get there for the opener and claim a spot on the grass.

social.title: Beers at Beer Bar
social.description: Long communal tables, a huge beer list and bratwurst — a beer hall that fills up fast on weekend nights.
social.bonus: Sit next to strangers at a communal table and start a conversation.

social.title: Real Salt Lake at America First Field
social.description: MLS in a stadium with mountains behind the stands and a supporters' section that sings for the full ninety minutes.
social.bonus: Buy tickets near the supporters' end and learn one chant.

social.title: Utah Mammoth Game at the Delta Center
social.description: Utah's new NHL team, playing to a city that has fallen hard for hockey in just a couple of seasons.
social.bonus: Get there for warm-ups and stand at the glass.

social.title: Pints at Proper Brewing
social.description: A Central 9th brewery with a big patio, a burger bar next door and a crowd that makes it easy to stay for another round.
social.bonus: Order a flight and rank it with your group.

social.title: Cocktails at Water Witch
social.description: A small, loud neighbourhood cocktail bar that is regularly named one of the best in the West.
social.bonus: Skip the menu and describe a mood to the bartender.

social.title: Utah Jazz Game at the Delta Center
social.description: Catch an NBA game live with a rowdy Jazz crowd at the Delta Center downtown.
social.bonus: High-five a stranger after the first made three.

social.title: Live Show at The Depot
social.description: Catch a touring band at this historic downtown venue built inside an old train depot.
social.bonus: Buy the opener's merch before you know a single song.

social.title: Trivia Night at Bar X
social.description: Squeeze into SLC's oldest cocktail bar for trivia night and a perfectly stirred Manhattan.
social.bonus: Team up with strangers at the next table.

social.title: Board Game Night at Squatters Pub
social.description: Grab a house-brewed beer and a board game with friends at this downtown brewpub institution.
social.bonus: Play a game none of you have played before.

chill.title: Wander Tracy Aviary
chill.description: One of the oldest public aviaries in the country, tucked into Liberty Park, with walk-through habitats and a free-flight bird show.

chill.title: Sunset from the Utah State Capitol Steps
chill.description: Sit on the Capitol's south steps on Capitol Hill as the sun drops over the valley and the lights come on downtown.
chill.bonus: Walk back down through the Marmalade district's old streets.

chill.title: Soak at Crystal Hot Springs
chill.description: An hour north of the city, where two natural springs — one hot, one cold — feed pools you can soak in under a big sky.
chill.bonus: Go on a cold night and watch the steam come off the water.

chill.title: Gilgal Sculpture Garden
chill.description: A hidden folk-art garden behind a residential block, home to a stone sphinx wearing the face of Joseph Smith and a dozen other strange carved pieces.
chill.bonus: Read every carved inscription before you leave.

chill.title: Browse Ken Sanders Rare Books
chill.description: A cavernous downtown shop stacked with rare, used and odd books on the West, Mormon history and everything in between.
chill.bonus: Find the oldest book you can afford and leave with it.

chill.title: Slow Loop Around Sugar House Park
chill.description: A wide, rolling park with a pond, big lawns and mountain views in every direction — the easiest reset in the city.
chill.bonus: Bring a blanket and pick the highest lawn.

chill.title: Soak at Fifth Water Hot Springs
chill.description: Hike two miles to the turquoise cascading pools of Fifth Water Hot Springs and soak it out.
chill.bonus: Pack a thermos of tea for the hike back.

chill.title: Wander Red Butte Garden
chill.description: Stroll through themed gardens and mountain trails at the University of Utah's botanical garden.
chill.bonus: Find the garden that smells the best and text a friend about it.

chill.title: Sunset Loop at Liberty Park Pond
chill.description: Walk the loop around Liberty Park's duck pond as the light turns gold behind the mountains.
chill.bonus: Bring bread scraps for the ducks (the good kind).

chill.title: Coffee and a Book at Publik Coffee
chill.description: Post up with a pour-over and a pastry at one of SLC's coziest local coffee roasters.
chill.bonus: Leave your phone in your bag for the whole visit.

adventure.title: Summit Mount Olympus
adventure.description: The peak that looms over the whole east side of the valley — over 4,000 feet of gain and a final hands-on scramble to the top.
adventure.bonus: Start before dawn and be on the summit block before the sun hits the trail.

adventure.title: Wildflowers at Cecret Lake
adventure.description: A short trail from the top of Little Cottonwood Canyon at Albion Basin to a small alpine lake ringed by some of the best summer wildflowers in the Wasatch.
adventure.bonus: Look for moose in the willows on the walk up.

adventure.title: Ride the Snowbird Aerial Tram to Hidden Peak
adventure.description: Ten minutes in a cable car from the base of Snowbird to 11,000 feet, with the whole Wasatch laid out and the Great Salt Lake glinting on the horizon.
adventure.bonus: Ride up, then hike the Peruvian Gulch trail back down instead of taking the tram.

adventure.title: Bonneville Shoreline Trail to the Living Room
adventure.description: A short, punchy climb above the University of Utah to a lookout where hikers have stacked flat rocks into armchairs facing the whole valley.
adventure.bonus: Go for sunset and claim a chair before everyone else does.

adventure.title: Bobsled Ride at Utah Olympic Park
adventure.description: Ride the 2002 Olympic track in the back of a four-person sled piloted by a pro, pulling up to five G's through the turns.
adventure.bonus: Watch the freestyle aerialists land into the pool before your run.

adventure.title: Hike to Lake Blanche
adventure.description: A steep, relentless climb out of Big Cottonwood Canyon that pays off with an alpine lake sitting under the red quartzite wall of Sundial Peak.
adventure.bonus: Scramble up the slabs past the lake for the view back down all three lakes.

adventure.title: Road Ride up Emigration Canyon
adventure.description: The city's classic bike climb — a steady grade from the zoo up to Little Mountain Summit, shared with half the cyclists in Salt Lake on a Saturday morning.
adventure.bonus: Stop at Ruth's on the way back down if you still have legs.

adventure.title: Public Skate at the Utah Olympic Oval
adventure.description: Skate the same 400-meter long-track oval where world records were set in 2002, under a huge suspended roof.
adventure.bonus: Try one full lap of the long track without stopping.

adventure.title: Backcountry Snowshoe in Big Cottonwood Canyon
adventure.description: Trek fresh powder in Big Cottonwood Canyon with a guided backcountry snowshoe outfitter.
adventure.bonus: Take a photo at the ridge before you turn back.

adventure.title: Hike Ensign Peak at Sunrise
adventure.description: Climb the short trail above the Capitol for a 360° sunrise view over the whole valley.
adventure.bonus: Bring coffee and watch the sun clear the Wasatch.

adventure.title: Mountain Bike the Corner Canyon Trails
adventure.description: Rip through flowy, machine-built singletrack in Draper's Corner Canyon trail system.
adventure.bonus: Try a trail you've never ridden before.

adventure.title: Explore Antelope Island State Park
adventure.description: Drive the causeway onto the Great Salt Lake's biggest island and spot free-roaming bison herds.
adventure.bonus: Dip a toe in the famously salty water.

adventure.title: Bike the City Creek Canyon Trail
adventure.description: Pedal the shaded, car-free road up City Creek Canyon right from downtown.
adventure.bonus: Ride to the top gate and back without stopping.

adventure.title: Ski or Ride Alta
adventure.description: Carve legendary Utah powder at Alta, one of the snowiest and most storied ski resorts in the country.
adventure.bonus: Take one run without stopping to check your phone.

adventure.title: Rock Climb at Momentum Indoor Climbing
adventure.description: Work up a sweat on the walls at one of SLC's biggest indoor climbing gyms.
adventure.bonus: Try a route two grades above your comfort zone.
